text:
A light-emitting diode (LED) is connected to a battery and glows.
The LED is then connected to the battery the other way round.
Which statement is correct?
A
The LED will not glow.
B
The LED will still glow but less brightly.
C
The LED will glow more brightly.
D
The current in the LED will be too large.

options.label: B
options.text: The LED will still glow but less brightly.

options.label: C
options.text: The LED will glow more brightly.

options.label: D
options.text: The current in the LED will be too large.
